_doc: What the hotel's rules cost in Wybe's sim (jury round 5, domain reviews). Hotel-rules mode on side branch hamad/hotelrules at 70d5be4 (NS_HOTEL_RULES=1; default off, byte-identical): knock before every keycard entry, never move a sign off a wet floor, avoid known-wet corridors, sign an unreported patch after a slip. Live: four practice nights started 05:49 Sun 8 Nov, measured complete at ~05:55 on seeds 10/16/23/5 (ledger.csv rows of commit 70d5be4); the final build's nights on the same seeds are c3801e0's (013f90d, the same agent as 8de9ffc, scored 1 point lower on seed 10). Keycard entries and knocks counted with masterKeyEntries (conduct.ts) over the eight logs. Replay: the replay bed on 164 real nights, as reported by the controller.
